posts.meta_description:
ahalive on September 14, 2026: "Created exclusively for Sphere Las Vegas, AHA is Oprah Winfrey’s dream for the world — a once-in-a-lifetime, immersive journey for the soul.

Join Oprah and a global collective of musicians, artists and storytellers at Sphere in Las Vegas, April 2–4, for a breathtaking journey of light, sound, music, storytelling, nature and shared humanity — designed to remind us what we’ve always known to be true. Visit AHALive.com for presale signup and Vibee Travel packages.

VIBEE Travel Packages on sale Tuesday, September 15 at 10 AM PT.

Tickets on sale Friday, September 25 at 10 AM PT.".

posts.meta_description:
ahalive on September 30, 2026: "AH-Answered: Here are a few of the most commonly asked questions about AHA - 

1. Will @oprah be there for every show? YES!

2. Is this a concert? If not, what really is it? While there is music—extraordinary music—think of AHA as a fully immersive, multi-sensory journey for the soul. No two people will leave with the same experience. 

3. Can I bring my child/teenager? 12+ is recommended, however, AHA is built for every generation at once — the artists on that stage span five decades of the culture.

4. Is every show the same? Yes. There are four performances throughout the weekend.

For more, please visit ahalive.com".
